**Source**: `7c2b8f012` `fix(migrations): fail closed on 341 rollback instead of deleting actor properties (MUL-6305)`

**AC**:
- New migration 259 (next after 258 from 0.5.33) — `341_drop_actor_properties.down` becomes fail-closed

- Test: rollback of 341 when actor rows exist returns error, does not drop
- Fork's `concurrentIndexCleanups` registry does NOT need a new entry (no CONCURRENTLY in 341)

**Verification**:
- `go test -run TestMigrations ./cmd/migrate/`

- Restore: `go run ./cmd/migrate up` returns 0

**Agent scope**: 1 worktree, 1 atomic commit. ~50 LOC. Single-shot safe.

## Execution strategy

### Worktree isolation

Each task runs in a dedicated worktree off `epic/0.5.13-integration`:
- `wt-0.5.36-1-mul6305` → `feat/0.5.36-mul6305`
- `wt-0.5.36-2-mul6300` → `feat/0.5.36-mul6300`
- `wt-0.5.36-3-mul6334` → `feat/0.5.36-mul6334`
- `wt-0.5.36-4-mul6272` → `feat/0.5.36-mul6272`
- `wt-0.5.36-5-mul5651` → `feat/0.5.36-mul5651`
- `wt-0.5.36-6-mul6243-foundation` → `feat/0.5.36-mul6243-foundation`
- `wt-0.5.36-7-mul6243-ui` → `feat/0.5.36-mul6243-ui`

### Parallelism model

- Tasks 1-5: independent (different files, different subsystems) → run in parallel
- Task 6: depends on 0.5.33-34 groundwork (already in fork); independent of Tasks 1-5 → run in parallel with 1-5
- Task 7: depends on Task 6 (uses `useIssueStatuses` hook from Task 6) → run AFTER Task 6 lands

### Main-thread commit pattern (per 0.5.33 lesson)

For each task worktree:
1. Agent returns with UNCOMMITTED changes
2. Main thread: `git diff` review (already verified build+tests by agent)
3. Main thread: `git add` + `git commit` (atomic commit on feature branch)
4. Main thread: cherry-pick to `epic/0.5.13-integration`
5. After all 7 cherry-picked: main thread bumps `apps/desktop/package.json` to 0.5.36, ships via `bash scripts/ship-mac.sh --yes`

### Thrash mitigation

- Each agent brief: ≤2000 LOC explicit scope, file list, forbidden patterns (Lark/Windows/telemetry/OAuth)
- Each agent: hard rule "no big reads, no full go test ./internal/..., no pnpm build, copy-not-read"
- Each agent: returns UNCOMMITTED, main thread does commit + cherry-pick + ship
- Task 7 (5476 LOC): may split into 2 sub-agents (UI presentation + settings page) if first attempt thrashes

### Verification gates (mandatory before main-thread commit)

- `pnpm typecheck --force` (full turbo) — per CLAUDE.md ship gate
- `cd server && go build ./...` — per CLAUDE.md ship gate
- `go test -count=1 -timeout 180s ./internal/<touched>/...` — narrow scope, not full sweep
- `pnpm test --filter @multica/views -- <touched>` — narrow scope
- Pre-existing panic check (Task 6/7 may touch issuestatus package → re-verify `TestTickSupervision_CompletionByFinalIssueStatus` fails identically on baseline if it appears)

## Risk register

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Task 7 (5476 LOC) thrashes agent | Split into 2 sub-agents (UI presentation + settings page); main-thread commit step |
| Cherry-pick conflicts on Tasks 6/7 (overlap with 0.5.33-34) | Agent reads conflict markers + applies semantic change by hand; main-thread commit documents the deviation in commit message |
| Pre-existing test panic returns as regression | Re-verify on baseline; only block ship if stack trace DIFFERS from 0.5.34 |
| Migration 259 (Task 1) conflicts with another migration in flight | `git log --all --oneline | grep -i migration` before task start to confirm no overlap |
| Test isolation breaks (MUL-6303 `singletonOwner` symbol issue in 0.5.35) | Task 7 may have similar issue; if so, wrap in ref-based pattern (low priority fixup) |
| Cwd drift (`.claude/worktrees/` 0.5.35 issue) | All agents operate in dedicated worktrees, never in main checkout |
| Git stash pitfall (testdata fixtures dirty) | Don't use stash; use worktrees for isolation |

## Cancellation criteria

- TypeScript typecheck fails with non-cosmetic errors → fix before ship
- `pnpm dev:desktop` smoke crashes on cold start → halt ship
